One name, one proof, one entry: Windbound hoy man slipway licence enforces it, and a licence men renew after dock reviews is how the check runs. Nobody is waved through free: a deposit of 22 credits, frozen until 10 days after the grading closes is the price, and the summit never covers it twice. Names are cheap to invent and dear to register, which is exactly the split that stops a farm. Every knoll is counted once. The reef is checked, not assumed.
